headwaters.title: Zoo Lights
headwaters.blurb: Millions of lights and Thomas Dambo's giant TROLLS fill Assiniboine Park Zoo, with Santa photos until Dec 23.

headwaters.title: Canad Inns Winter Wonderland
headwaters.meta: Through Jan 2 · Red River Exhibition Park
headwaters.blurb: Western Canada's largest drive-through light show, with free Clydesdale hayrides on weekends and pond skating.

events.title: 13th Annual Indigenous Art & Crafts Sale
events.time: Sat 10 AM - 6 PM, Sun 9 AM - 4 PM
events.blurb: Beadwork, moccasins, ribbon skirts, art and bannock fill the old CPR station rotunda for one of the city's biggest Indigenous-made holiday sales, with a fashion show Sunday at 2 PM.

events.title: Adrian Sutherland & Jade Turner
events.venue: West End Cultural Centre, 586 Ellice Ave
events.blurb: Double bill of Indigenous roots and country: Attawapiskat's Adrian Sutherland and Misipawistik Cree Nation's Jade Turner. All ages, $30-35.

events.title: Alistair Ogden at The Basement
events.venue: The Basement Comedy Club, 3740 Portage Ave
events.blurb: Rising Canadian stand-up Alistair Ogden headlines The Basement; the Friday show is already sold out.

events.title: Alive in the Woods
events.blurb: A day of guided outdoor exploration and nature connection activities across the FortWhyte trails.

events.title: Amanda Marshall
events.blurb: Canadian pop-rock icon Amanda Marshall performs her signature hits at the historic Burt. A marquee homegrown draw.

events.title: An Oddly Fantastical Holiday Market
events.venue: Fort Rouge Leisure Centre, 625 Osborne St
events.blurb: An Oddly Curious Market and Fantastical Emporium team up for 40+ vendors of unusual goods, live music, photos with a giant Yule Cat and hot chocolate from Grýla's Goodies. $5 at the door, with part of proceeds to Rainbow Resource Centre; some art has adult themes.

events.title: ArtsForward's Glorious Christmas Wish Sale
events.blurb: More than 50 tables of local crafts, original art and specialty goods plus a Santa meet-and-greet, alongside Neepawa's Holiday on Main and Super Saturday festivities.

events.title: Bassem Youssef
events.blurb: The Egyptian satirist and former heart surgeon often called 'the Jon Stewart of Egypt' brings his stand-up to the Concert Hall.

events.title: Bison Bus Tour
events.blurb: A guided bus ride out onto FortWhyte's prairie to see the bison herd up close in its winter coats, with an interpreter on board. Register through FortWhyte's online store.

events.title: Bisons Basketball vs. Regina
events.venue: Investors Group Athletic Centre, University of Manitoba
events.blurb: Canada West basketball doubleheader with the Manitoba Bisons women's and men's teams hosting Regina.

events.title: Bud & Bloom Holiday Jingle
events.venue: Selkirk Rec Complex, 180 Easton Dr, Selkirk
events.blurb: A holiday makers' market at the Selkirk Rec Complex, with local vendors, handmade gifts and seasonal treats.

events.title: Canad Inns Winter Wonderland
events.blurb: Western Canada's largest drive-through holiday light show runs nightly through Jan 2, 2027, from $30 per vehicle. KB Clydesdales give free horse-drawn hayrides Fri-Sun and on New Year's Eve, there's pond skating, and the first 100 cars on Wednesdays get free 3D glasses. Santa visits Dec 11 and the Grinch Dec 4 & 18.

events.title: Canalta Craft and Vendor Sale
events.blurb: A recurring craft and vendor sale at Selkirk's Canalta Hotel. After this one, the next date is Dec 12.

events.title: Christmas at CMU
events.venue: Assiniboine Castle, Canadian Mennonite University, 500 Shaftesbury Blvd
events.blurb: Canadian Mennonite University's annual promenade concert. You walk through the heritage castle while CMU Singers, the handbell ensemble, the concert band and others perform, with cookies and hot apple cider. The 7pm show is livestreamed.

events.title: Christmas Market on Willowlake
events.blurb: A free two-day church Christmas market with handmade goods and holiday baking. Proceeds go to Hope Community Center, an orphanage in Kenya, and to ministries in Nairobi.

events.title: Cookie Walk & Craft Sale
events.blurb: Walk past tables of homemade decorated cookies and fill a box with your favourites, then shop a craft sale of gifts from local businesses. Proceeds support the church.

events.title: One eye filled with night
events.blurb: Nadja Pelkey leads a walk-through of Laura Lewis's exhibition — a good excuse to finally see the show.

events.title: DnR Winter Market Gifts & Crafts
events.venue: Selkirk Friendship Centre, 425 Eveline St, Selkirk
events.blurb: A winter gifts-and-crafts market in Selkirk on the same day as the town's Santa Parade of Lights, so you can make a day of it.

events.title: Fall Into Fiddling Summit: Old Time Dance
events.blurb: The Red River Fiddle & Dance Society caps its fall fiddling summit with an old-time dance open to all. Dance-only tickets are $20 for adults, $10 for ages 6-17 and free for kids 5 and under; the $85 summit registration includes workshops and the dance.

events.title: Family Engineering Fun
events.blurb: Take on engineering challenges and build with blocks, Keva Planks, K'nex and more. Drop-in for children and their families.

events.title: Family Fun Afternoon
events.blurb: A free Saturday drop-in with games, activities and a pile of good books for kids and their families.

events.title: Family Tech Afternoon
events.blurb: Drop-in hands-on play with robots, circuits and simple programming for kids and their families. Free, no registration; it returns Dec 19.

events.title: Family Train Time
events.blurb: Free wooden-train play for toddlers and preschoolers with their grown-ups. It repeats at Sir William Stephenson Library (Dec 5), St. John's Library (Dec 12) and Louis Riel Library (Dec 22).

events.title: Festival of Trees
events.venue: Clarion Lakeside Inn, 470 1st Ave S, Kenora, ON
events.blurb: The 23rd annual Kenora and Lake of the Woods Community Foundation fundraiser, themed "Holiday with Heart": a daytime Community Day with decorated trees and local musicians, then a ticketed evening gala dinner with live and silent auctions.

events.title: Gala of Gifts
events.venue: Art Gallery of Southwestern Manitoba, Brandon
events.blurb: The Brandon gallery's holiday sale of artist-made gifts, including works and crafts by regional makers.

events.title: Gold Leaf Christmas Craft Market
events.blurb: Over 90 local makers and small businesses, a free kids' craft table, bracelet bar, gift-wrap station and Santa on Sunday 2-4 pm. $5 admission covers both days, 12 and under free.

events.title: Good Neighbours Active Living Centre Christmas & Craft Sale
events.venue: Good Neighbours Active Living Centre, 720 Henderson Hwy
events.blurb: The annual Christmas and craft sale at the East Kildonan active-living centre, with crafts, baking and gift tables. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Happy Paw-lidays Market
events.venue: Ukrainian Orthodox Church of All Saints, 1500 Day St
events.blurb: A Transcona holiday makers' market put on by Winnipeg Giant Breed Rescue, with proceeds going to the rescue's foster dogs.

events.title: Impressions Jazz Group
events.venue: King Cob Market Pub, 580 Ellice Ave
events.blurb: The Jazz Workshop Winnipeg presents the Impressions Jazz Group and guests at West End pub King Cob. No cover.

events.title: In the Nick of Time Craft and Bake Sale
events.venue: Little Britain United Church Hall, 5879 Hwy 9, Lockport
events.blurb: An old-school church-hall craft and bake sale on Highway 9 in Lockport, good for pies, preserves and handmade gifts.

events.title: Izzy Asper Jazz Performances: Jane Monheit - One Night Only
events.venue: Desautels Concert Hall, University of Manitoba, 150 Dafoe Rd W
events.blurb: Jazz vocalist Jane Monheit in the Rady JCC's Izzy Asper Jazz series. Adults $45, under 30 $25.

events.title: Kenora Kinsmen Santa Claus Parade
events.venue: Central Park to Main St loop, Kenora, ON
events.blurb: Kenora's 105-year-old Santa parade rolls out of Central Park with a "Rock 'n' Roll Christmas" theme. Pair it with the Festival of Trees the same day for a lake-country holiday road trip.

events.title: LEGO at the Library
events.blurb: A free LEGO build session for ages 6-12; all bricks stay at the library. It runs again at Harvey Smith Library on Dec 12 and Munroe Library on Dec 14.

events.title: Latinas Manitoba Christmas Pop-Up Market
events.blurb: A free Latin American community Christmas market with a morning session and an evening session. Shop local vendors and handmade gifts with a Latin flavour.

events.title: Laura Lewis Curatorial Talk & Tour
events.blurb: Curatorial talk and tour.

events.title: Learn to Play Warhammer 40k
events.venue: GameKnight Games and Cool Stuff, 519 Osborne St
events.blurb: A free drop-in session with the Gaming Under the Ice community. Loaner armies are provided, and veterans can bring 1000-point lists for casual games.

events.title: Lower Fort Garry Holiday Market
events.venue: Lower Fort Garry visitor centre, St. Andrews
events.blurb: Handmade gifts, festive decor, artisan goods and seasonal treats inside the Lower Fort Garry visitor centre, plus a Santa pancake breakfast and photos with Santa. Free admission.

events.title: MCO Vinyl Vault
events.blurb: The Manitoba Chamber Orchestra's monthly record sale has about 15,000 LPs in almost every genre, all $3 each, and the money supports the MCO. There's no December sale; the next one is Jan 30.

events.title: Made in the Middle Craft Market
events.blurb: A long-running juried craft market showcasing handmade, non-mass-produced work by Manitoba artists, tucked into the Norwood Community Centre.

events.title: Makers Market Grad Fundraiser
events.venue: Nelson McIntyre Collegiate, 188 St. Mary's Rd
events.blurb: A makers' market in Norwood raising money for Nelson McIntyre Collegiate's graduating class. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Moose vs. Belleville Senators
events.blurb: Weekend-afternoon AHL hockey, with a second game against Belleville on Sunday, Nov 29 at 2:00 PM.

events.title: Mrs. Claus at CF Polo Park
events.blurb: Mrs. Claus makes weekend appearances at Polo Park through December 20 as part of Cadillac Fairview's holiday programming. The mall also has LEGO mini-builds and a Toy Mountain donation bin.

events.title: Navy League of Canada Christmas Market
events.blurb: A Christmas market in Brandon hosted by the Navy League of Canada, with local vendors and holiday gifts.

events.title: Nob Jazz Nights with Emmanuel Bach Trio
events.venue: The Nob @ St Norbert Hotel, 3540 Pembina Hwy
events.blurb: Free Saturday-night jazz with the Emmanuel Bach Trio and rotating guests at the St. Norbert Hotel. It runs weekly through December.

events.title: Oakville Annual Christmas Market
events.blurb: A yearly small-town Christmas market west of Winnipeg, with local crafts and baking for holiday shopping.

events.title: Opening Doors: Métis Career & Employment Opportunities Conference
events.venue: Hilton Winnipeg Airport Suites, 1800 Wellington Ave
events.blurb: Métis Employment & Training hosts two days for Red River Métis Citizens who are students, job seekers or career changers to meet employers, explore training and connect with Métis businesses and MMF programs.

events.title: PAW-TY TIME – A Benefit for K9 Advocacy Group
events.blurb: A benefit night for K9 Advocacy Group at the Exchange District's Royal Albert, listed by the Pyramid Cabaret. Runs 8 to 11:30 PM; lineup not yet posted.

events.title: Plug In ICA Curatorial Talk & Tour
events.venue: Plug In Institute of Contemporary Art
events.blurb: Curatorial talk and tour of One Eye Filled with Night.

events.title: Promenade guidée du bison
events.blurb: A French-language guided walk out to meet FortWhyte's bison herd. Returns Dec 26.

events.title: ResponderPalooza 2026 – Night 2
events.blurb: First-responder musicians pay tribute to Kings of Leon, Weezer and Foo Fighters in the second night of this Dream Factory of Manitoba fundraiser. Last year sold out; limited weekend passes also cover Night 1 at the Park Theatre.

events.title: Ripperz
events.blurb: Winnipeg rockers Ripperz celebrate a new album with an all-ages release show. Doors 7 PM.

events.title: Roadhouse 52 Christmas Artisan Market
events.venue: Road House 52 Inn & Suites, 375 Northfront Dr, Steinbach
events.blurb: A one-day artisan Christmas market in Steinbach with local makers selling handmade gifts.

events.title: Santa Photos & Christmas Fair
events.venue: Valley Gardens Community Centre, 220 Antrim Rd
events.blurb: Manitoba Mutts Dog Rescue's annual fundraiser: professional photos with Santa ($15/person, leashed dogs welcome) plus baked goods, crafts and rescue merch for sale. Book photo slots via fundraising@manitobamutts.org.

events.title: Santa at the Marsh
events.venue: Oak Hammock Marsh Wetland Discovery Centre, 1 Snow Goose Bay (near Stonewall)
events.blurb: Holiday day at Oak Hammock Marsh with a craft, holiday bingo, bannock and a visit with Santa. Regular admission applies; photos with Santa are $5 per family.

events.title: Santa in the Forest
events.blurb: Family photos with Santa in FortWhyte's snowy forest, with time to share holiday wishes. Both final weekend dates are listed as sold out, so check for cancellations.

events.title: Santa's One Stop Shop Market
events.venue: St. Andrews Community Club, 28 St. Andrews Rd, St. Andrews
events.blurb: A holiday vendor market hosted by The Market on Main. Admission is a donation to the Christmas Cheer Board, such as a new unwrapped toy, a non-perishable food item or a silver collection.

events.title: Selkirk Santa Parade of Lights
events.venue: Berrisford Ave. to Superior Ave., Selkirk
events.blurb: The Santa Parade of Lights rolls through Selkirk for its 19th year with lit-up floats from local businesses and residents. The Selkirk Bridge closes 6:30-8:30 p.m., so arrive early.

events.title: Seven Sisters Falls Christmas Craft Sale
events.venue: Seven Sisters Falls Community Centre, 69 Townsite Rd, Seven Sisters Falls
events.blurb: A community-centre Christmas craft sale in Seven Sisters Falls on the Winnipeg River.

events.title: Silver Heights Saturday Afternoon Jazz
events.blurb: A weekly Saturday-afternoon jazz set (about 1 to 4 pm) at a St. James institution; this week it's Jon Gordon, Carter Graham, Steve Hamilton and Rob Siwik. $8 cover.

events.title: St. Anne Christmas Market
events.venue: St. Anne Ukrainian Catholic Parish, 35 Marcie St
events.blurb: A North Kildonan parish Christmas market with handmade crafts, decorations and gifts from local artisans, plus holiday baking and wheat for traditional Ukrainian kutia.

events.title: St. Charles Catholic School Christmas Craft Sale
events.venue: St. Charles Catholic School, 331 St. Charles St
events.blurb: A west-end school Christmas craft sale with tables of handmade goods. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: St. Michael's UCWLC Craft & Bake Sale
events.venue: St. Michael's Ukrainian Catholic Church hall, 400 Day St
events.blurb: The Ukrainian Catholic Women's League sells home-baked Christmas goods and perogies alongside tables from local crafters in Transcona.

events.title: St. Norbert Farmers' Market
events.venue: St. Norbert Farmers' Market, 3514 Pembina Hwy
events.blurb: The market's indoor winter season runs every Saturday through May 15, 2027, with Manitoba-grown produce, baking and local crafts. Holiday gift certificates are sold at the info booth.

events.title: Stash Bash 2026
events.venue: Times Change(d) High & Lonesome Club (234 Main St)
events.blurb: Movember Winnipeg's live music fundraiser party at Times Change(d).

events.title: Steve's Independent Makers Fair
events.blurb: A first annual handmade market for artists, makers, tinkerers and creative technologists lands in the Exchange District's Artspace building.

events.title: TROLLS: Save the Humans
events.blurb: Themed troll weekends at the Zoo, including a free guided Troll Translator Tour. This weekend has troll geocaching and a pot-painting craft to take home. Later weekends add gift-wrap crafts, and from January there are snowshoe walks and campfire marshmallows, running through Feb 7.

events.title: The Bloody Banquet
events.venue: Devil May Care Brewing Company, 155-A Fort St
events.blurb: The Wicked Bazaar turns the brewery into a gothic, Dracula-themed evening hosted by Batty Belle. It includes burlesque, interactive storytelling, grazing tables, a beer, live strings and tarot readings, and ends with a screening of Nosferatu.

events.title: The Natural Elements During the Freezing Water Moon
events.blurb: Knowledge keeper Marilyn Dykstra shares Inninewak (Cree) moon, pole and tea teachings on kinship — Wahkowtowin — over traditional tea. Free, but registration is required.

events.title: Traditional Irish Music with Cairde
events.blurb: An all-ages hour of traditional Irish tunes - penny whistle, fiddle and more - from Cairde, a group of friends who met at the Irish Association of Manitoba's slow sessions. Free, drop-in.

events.title: Tyndall Community Market: A Special Holiday Market
events.venue: Tyndall Park Community Hall, 2221 King Edward St
events.blurb: Alark Co. holiday pop-up in Tyndall Park with local vendors, family activities and a community hamper program.

events.title: Welcome 2 Winnipeg Comedy Show
events.venue: Ibex Restaurant & Event Space, 626 Sargent Ave
events.blurb: An 18+ stand-up night at Ibex on Sargent, headlined by Filmon "Gergish" Yohannes. Doors open at 7.

events.title: Wesmen Women's Volleyball vs. Saskatchewan
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Wesmen host Saskatchewan in Canada West women's volleyball downtown.

events.title: Windsor Park United Church Craft Sale
events.venue: Windsor Park United Church, 1062 Autumnwood Dr
events.blurb: A church-basement craft sale in Windsor Park with handmade gifts and home baking. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Winnipeg Mennonite School Christmas Market
events.venue: Winnipeg Mennonite School, Bedson Campus, 250 Bedson St
events.blurb: A Saturday Christmas market at the school's Bedson Street campus in St. James, with local vendors and holiday treats.

events.title: Wreath Making Workshop
events.venue: St. Andrews Heritage Centre, 374 River Rd, St. Andrews
events.blurb: Make your own fresh holiday wreath at a hands-on afternoon workshop in the historic St. Andrews Heritage Centre on River Road.

events.title: École Pointe-des-Chênes Christmas Market
events.venue: École Pointe-des-Chênes, 90 Arena Rd, Ste. Anne
events.blurb: A community Christmas market in Ste. Anne. It runs on two Saturdays, Nov 28 and again on Dec 5.

events.title: Lundar Craft Sale
events.blurb: An Interlake Christmas craft sale at the Lundar Legion, about 90 minutes northwest of Winnipeg. It is listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide.

events.title: Second Floor Patients with Courriers, The Program, sewnshut
events.blurb: An all-ages bill of Winnipeg heavy and post-hardcore bands at the Handsome Daughter. Tickets are $15 through Gigpit.

events.title: Candlelight: The Best of Hans Zimmer
events.blurb: A candlelit afternoon concert of Beatles, Queen, Rolling Stones and other British rock classics, arranged for strings.

events.title: Anne of Green Gables: The Musical
events.venue: Royal MTC John Hirsch Mainstage, 174 Market Ave
events.blurb: Royal MTC's holiday-season mainstage show is the classic Canadian musical about red-headed orphan Anne Shirley, directed and choreographed by Julie Tomaino. It runs until December 20, with Saturday shows at 2:00 and 7:30 PM, and it suits the whole family.

events.title: Comfort Food
events.venue: Royal MTC Tom Hendry Warehouse, 140 Rupert Ave
events.blurb: Crow's Theatre's two-person play by Zorana Sadiq, about a fading cooking-show host and her son, uses real cooking and live camera work. It runs about 100 minutes with no intermission, through Dec 6.

events.title: The Incomplete Dictionary of Lexical Gaps
events.blurb: Samantha Machado's debut play is about an awkward dinner party between empty-nesters and a couple they've never met, which twists into a situation with no name. It runs 85 minutes, the Nov 28 evening show is audio-described, and the run closes Nov 29.

events.title: Oliver!
events.blurb: Final weekend of a community staging of Lionel Bart's musical. Two shows Saturday and a 2 PM Sunday matinee on Nov 29; $30 general admission.

events.title: My Brother's Wedding
events.blurb: 4K restoration of Charles Burnett's 1985 South Central LA tragicomedy, about a young man torn between his best friend's funeral and his brother's wedding. Screens Nov 28-29 and Dec 1-2.

events.title: Mare's Nest
events.blurb: Ben Rivers' 2026 film, adapted from a Don DeLillo play, follows a child named Moon through a strange world with no adults. Screens through Dec 3.

events.title: November Members' Exhibition
events.blurb: aceartinc.'s annual open showcase of work in all media by its active members. Closes Dec 4.

events.title: 30th Anniversary 50-500 Members Exhibition
events.venue: Urban Shaman Contemporary Aboriginal Art, 203-290 McDermot Ave
events.blurb: Urban Shaman's annual members' show, with every work priced between $50 and $500. This is the 30th-anniversary edition, on view through Dec 19.

events.title: Soul Baring, A Path Without a Mother
events.blurb: Solo exhibition by Surien Fourie in the Exchange District, on view through Dec 19.

events.title: Memories of the Gen X Generation
events.venue: C2 Centre for Craft, 1-329 Cumberland Ave
events.blurb: Craft exhibition at C2 Centre for Craft looking back on Gen X memories. Through Dec 17.

events.title: Fired
events.venue: Manitoba Crafts Museum and Library, C2 Centre for Craft, 1-329 Cumberland Ave
events.blurb: Ceramics by 33 artists from the 1950s to the 2020s, drawn from the MCML collection and including Jack Sures, Marilyn Levine and Leo Mol. Runs until Jan 15, 2027.

events.title: Moonlight / klayr di leun
events.venue: Gallery 1C03, University of Winnipeg, 515 Portage Ave
events.blurb: Solo show by Red River Métis/settler artist Nichol Marsch, mixing traditional craft and mixed media to explore memory, the body and identity. Free, on view through Jan 29, 2027.

events.title: Home: a MAWA Members' Show + Sale
events.blurb: Work on the theme of 'home' by 110 MAWA members, most of it for sale with all proceeds going to the artists. A First Friday closing party runs Dec 4, 6-9 PM.

events.title: Laurence Belzile Exhibition
events.blurb: New paintings by Laurence Belzile inspired by six women painters. Free, on view until Jan 22, 2027.

events.title: Terra Cognita/Incognita
events.blurb: More than 125 historical and contemporary landscape works from WAG-Qaumajuq's collection, plus local artists Anna Binta Diallo, Sarah Fuller, Debra Frances Plett and a new commission by Lourdes Still.

events.title: Diane Whitehouse: Paintings
events.blurb: Seven of Diane Whitehouse's pastel-hued abstract paintings with assemblage elements, plus recent watercolours and charcoal drawings. Closes Dec 12.

events.title: Christkindlmarkt
events.venue: Fort Garry Place Mall, 81 Garry St entrance
events.blurb: Canada's oldest German Christmas market, run by the German-Canadian Congress since 1985: German baking, stollen, imported ornaments and Manitoba-made gifts. Free admission, with a suggested $2 donation.

events.title: Ethiopian Basket Weaving Workshop with Netsanet Shawl
events.blurb: A free hands-on workshop in traditional Ethiopian weaving, led by Ethiopian-Canadian artist Netsanet Shawl, with materials and Ethiopian coffee included. Part of the Culture Roots in the Village series. Upstairs, so not wheelchair accessible. The listing gives two different start times; confirm before going.

events.title: O. Koshetz Choir 80th Anniversary
events.venue: Oseredok Ukrainian Cultural and Educational Centre, 184 Alexander Ave E
events.blurb: A special exhibition on eight decades of the O. Koshetz Choir and Ukrainian choral music in Winnipeg, open until Dec 30.

events.title: Ukrainian Voice: A Legacy Mosaic
events.venue: Oseredok Ukrainian Cultural and Educational Centre, 184 Alexander Ave E
events.blurb: More than 6,000 printing blocks rescued from the Trident Press, laid out as a large mosaic of pioneers, community leaders, ads and embroidery patterns, with historic copies of the Ukrainian Voice newspaper. Runs to March 31, 2027.

events.title: Peter Shostak: Stories of a New Land
events.venue: Oseredok Ukrainian Cultural and Educational Centre, 184 Alexander Ave E
events.blurb: Highlights from Peter Shostak's 'For Our Children' paintings of Ukrainian pioneer life on the Prairies, on show at Oseredok since October.

events.title: Grant Park Holiday Pop Up
events.venue: Grant Park Shopping Centre, 1120 Grant Ave
events.blurb: The second annual pop-up brings local makers, artisans and small businesses to the mall, selling gifts, holiday decor and handmade goods. This weekend, ending Sunday Nov 29, is the last of its run. Entry is free.

events.title: Zoo Lights
events.time: 5:00 PM - 10:00 PM (last entry 9 PM), select nights
events.blurb: Assiniboine Park Zoo's walk-through holiday light festival runs 29 select nights until January 3, 2027. This year Thomas Dambo's giant TROLLS sculptures are part of the route, and there's hot chocolate by the fire, carolers and Santa. Tickets are timed and dated: $18 + GST for December and January nights, and kids 2 and under get in free.

events.title: Coca-Cola Holiday Caravan
events.blurb: The red Coca-Cola holiday truck is parked at The Forks for its second and final day there, with free festive photo ops. Stops can change, so check the schedule before you go.

events.title: Big Brothers Big Sisters Winter Wonderland
events.venue: Trinity United Church, 15 Tupper St S, Portage la Prairie
events.blurb: A Nutcracker-themed walk through decorated rooms, with a model train, live entertainment and a visit with Santa. An adults-only coffee house runs Saturday evening. Proceeds go to Big Brothers Big Sisters of Central Plains; tickets are $15 for adults, $5 for ages 6-12, and free for ages 5 and under.

events.title: Gardener Chats
events.blurb: A warm break from winter: chat with The Leaf's horticulture team in the biomes for inside knowledge on the plantings. Runs through Jan 9, 2027, except Dec 25, 26 and Jan 1.

events.title: The Paper Trail to the 1923 Chinese Exclusion Act
events.blurb: A temporary exhibition that follows the documents behind Canada's 1923 Chinese Exclusion Act. It's in the Manitoba Museum's Discovery Room and Urban Corridor until April 2027 and is included with museum admission.

events.title: Graham Clark
events.venue: Rumor's Restaurant & Comedy Club, 190-2025 Corydon Ave
events.blurb: Closing night of the three-time Canadian Comedy Award winner's week at Rumor's. Clark co-hosts the podcast Stop Podcasting Yourself and has appeared on The Debaters and This Hour Has 22 Minutes. The 9:45 show is sold out, but the 7:30 still had seats.

events.title: The Tempest
events.venue: Gas Station Arts Centre, 445 River Ave
events.blurb: 7 Ages Productions stages Shakespeare's tale of storms, magic and an exiled duke, directed by George Buri and Stephanie Choy. The run ends Nov 29 and tickets are about $32.

events.title: Introduction to Procreate
events.venue: Millennium Library, ideaMILL Classroom, 251 Donald St
events.blurb: Artist Cato Cormier teaches the basics of digital drawing in the Procreate app. The library provides the iPads, and the session is free for adults.

events.title: Silver Screen Matinee: White Christmas
events.blurb: A free afternoon screening of the 1954 Bing Crosby and Danny Kaye musical classic (PG, 120 min).

events.title: Binge Thinkers Trivia Night
events.blurb: Free trivia with three rounds across eight categories, including audio and video questions shown on multiple screens. Teams can have up to eight players, and there are prizes.

events.title: A Cup of Intrigue: Dwight Talks Spies!
events.blurb: Dwight MacAulay, past president of the Intrepid Society, tells the story of Winnipeg-born spymaster Sir William Stephenson over coffee and dainties. Space is limited; reserve by noon Nov 27.

events.title: A Reunion with Beethoven
events.venue: Desautels Concert Hall, 150 Dafoe Rd W
events.blurb: Cellist Minna Rose Chung joins Desautels alumni Gregory Lewis (violin) and Paul Williamson (piano) for Beethoven's Piano Trio Op. 70 No. 2, with conversation between pieces. Tickets are pay-what-you-can, up to about $28.

events.title: An Afternoon with Brad Gushue
events.blurb: Curling champion Brad Gushue talks about his book Gushue: The Making of a Champion, then signs copies. It is also streamed live on YouTube.

events.title: Anola Christmas Craft and Vendor Sale
events.blurb: A Sunday Christmas craft and vendor sale at the Anola Community Club, east of Winnipeg.

events.title: Behind the Scenes Zoo Experience: Toucan Ridge
events.blurb: A 60-minute behind-the-scenes visit, capped at 4 people, among the free-flying tropical birds of Toucan Ridge, covering how keepers care for them. It is the last date of the fall series. Cost is $46 + GST plus Zoo admission, ages 10+, and advance booking is required.

events.title: Bonfire Marshmallow Roast
events.blurb: Warm your mitts by a crackling bonfire and toast a marshmallow or three between trail walks. Back again Dec 5 and Dec 27.

events.title: Carve a Diamond Willow Walking Stick
events.blurb: A hands-on workshop led by Doug Mackie teaching the basics of carving a diamond willow walking stick.

events.title: Celebrating 60 Years of FortWhyte Alive
events.blurb: Free admission for everyone as FortWhyte Alive marks its 60th anniversary with a welcome ceremony, family activities (10 am-3 pm) and guided outdoor experiences across its 660 acres.

events.title: Christmas Sod House: A Dickens Christmas Carol!
events.blurb: Step into FortWhyte's pioneer sod house for a festive, interactive look at Manitoba's prairie past. Falls on FortWhyte's free-admission 60th anniversary day.

events.title: Coup de coeur Francophone: Bilinguish Boys with 2 gars s'essayent
events.venue: Salle Antoine-Gaborieau, Centre culturel franco-manitobain, 340 Provencher Blvd
events.blurb: The Winnipeg stop of the cross-Canada Coup de coeur francophone festival: Franco-Ontarian trio Bilinguish Boys mix music, humour and improv, with Winnipeg comedy duo 2 gars s'essayent opening. $30 advance, $35 at the door; students $20/$25.

events.title: Crokinole Tournament

events.title: Athletics Manitoba Last Chance Meet

events.blurb: Athletics Manitoba's December indoor meet. It's the last chance to post qualifying marks before the holiday break, with Bisons and club athletes competing on the U of M indoor track.

events.title: Bicycle Face Christmas: MyrrHvana's Greatest Hits
events.blurb: Local band Bicycle Face marks a decade of its irreverent Christmas show at the West End Cultural Centre.

events.title: CWE Super Jobber Cup

events.blurb: Canadian Wrestling's Elite holds its annual 2026 Super Jobber Cup tournament in Transcona. Tickets are $20 in advance and $25 at the door.

events.title: Cannes Lions

events.title: JP Hoe Hoe Hoe Holiday Show
events.blurb: JP Hoe's long-running Winnipeg holiday variety concert, presented by the Winnipeg Folk Festival.

events.title: Jazz Winnipeg's Big Winter Warm-Up
events.blurb: Jazz Winnipeg heats up a December Friday with a big-hearted evening of local players.

events.title: Moonlit Melodies
events.blurb: An intimate acoustic concert wrapped in FortWhyte's wintry woods after dark.

events.title: Portage 2 Person Stick Curling Bonspiel
events.venue: Portage Curling Club, Portage la Prairie
events.blurb: A weekend two-person stick curling bonspiel in Portage la Prairie, one of a growing circuit of stick events around the province.

events.title: Punk Rock Fundraiser Show for Sam
events.blurb: Winnipeg's punk community rallies for one of its own with a fundraiser bill at Sidestage. About $19, all ages.

events.title: Saigon Story: Two Shootings in the Forest Kingdom
events.blurb: Kim Nguyen traces the link between two families and the famous 'Saigon Execution' photograph.

events.title: Strathcona Trust Senior Men's Regional Qualifiers

events.title: Winter Wonderland at the Manitoba Agricultural Museum
events.blurb: The museum's pioneer village lights up for three evenings of holiday atmosphere. $5 admission, children 5 and under free.

events.title: Yule Cat Paint Night

events.title: Zoo Lights Sensory Night
events.blurb: A lower-sensory version of Zoo Lights with reduced sound and lighting, a quiet room, and smaller crowds.

events.title: Beginner Cookie Decorating Class
events.venue: Deer Lodge Community Centre, 323 Bruce Ave
events.blurb: A hands-on evening learning to decorate holiday sugar cookies, with all supplies provided. It's the last class of the year.

events.title: Queerly Baking
events.blurb: A free, inclusive baking group where 2SLGBTQ+ folks of every skill level bake together and connect.

events.title: A Cabaret of Legends
events.venue: Royal MTC Tom Hendry Warehouse, 140 Rupert Ave
events.blurb: Tymisha Harris's cabaret, a sell-out at this summer's Fringe, traces her own story through songs by Billie Holiday, Aretha Franklin, Tina Turner and Beyoncé. Three performances only, as a Winnipeg Fringe fundraiser. Tickets are $50 ($40 early bird before Dec 1), ages 14+.

events.title: Brandon Wheat Kings vs. Edmonton Oil Kings

events.title: B.A. Johnston

events.blurb: Maritime DIY road-warrior BA Johnston headlines with local acts Blond Goth and The Lizzards.

events.title: Bombay Nights: Winnipeg Edition
events.blurb: A Bollywood/Bombay-themed nightclub party with South Asian music.

events.venue: The Basement Speakeasy, 3740 Portage Ave (Howard Johnson Hotel)
events.blurb: Prairie Diva's festive cabaret brings classic burlesque, dancers and sparkle to a 1920s-style speakeasy, with the same acts on both nights. It's 18+, seats are very limited, and couch VIP tables are available.

events.title: CPTC Ice Oval Season Opener

events.blurb: Canadian Wrestling's Elite brings a night of indie pro wrestling to Beausejour. Tickets are $16 in advance and $21 at the door, and VIP early entry is available.

events.title: Christmas Baking Workshop: Pets de sœur
events.blurb: Boulangerie St-Pierre Bakery teaches the traditional French-Canadian cinnamon swirls in a hands-on holiday session — and you take the batch home. $60.

events.venue: FortWhyte Farms, FortWhyte Alive, 1961 McCreary Rd
events.blurb: A day-long woodshop workshop at FortWhyte Farms where you build handmade bandsaw boxes to give as gifts. It costs $140 for members and $150 for non-members, and fees are non-refundable. FortWhyte's woodworking classes this season have been selling out.

events.title: Curubande Allstars — Concurso de Salsa
events.blurb: Live salsa from the Curubande Allstars with a salsa dance contest at the West End Cultural Centre.

events.title: Dalnavert Museum Christmas Craft Market
events.blurb: Shop local crafts in and around a Victorian mansion dressed for the holidays at Dalnavert Museum's annual Christmas craft market.

events.title: Deutsches Frühstück

events.blurb: The German-Canadian Congress's monthly German breakfast, made with food from local German suppliers. You need to register ahead through the Congress.

events.blurb: Free drop-in arts and crafts station for children and families. The same afternoon also runs at Louis Riel and Sir William Stephenson libraries, with another at Fort Garry Library on Dec 22.

events.title: Family Scrabble Club
events.blurb: Friendly, non-competitive Scrabble for kids and their families, a chance to build vocabulary together. Boards are provided and it's free.

events.title: Fin de Ano en Comunidad!
events.blurb: A Latin American community celebration with music and dancing to mark the coming new year.

events.title: Folklorama 365: Ukrainian Cross Stitch Workshop
events.venue: The Leaf at Assiniboine Park, 145 The Leaf Way
events.blurb: Learn Ukrainian cross-stitch embroidery and the culture behind it with a Folklorama instructor; bring a garment or tote bag to embroider. $60 plus GST, tickets through Assiniboine Park.

events.title: Harry Manx
events.blurb: Harry Manx, the 'mysticssippi' bluesman who mixes Delta blues with Indian ragas on slide guitar and mohan veena, plays an intimate concert at the Crescent Arts Centre. Tickets are $30–$60.

events.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas in Concert
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Symphony Orchestra plays the score live while the film screens overhead, part of the Asper Night at the Movies series. The Sunday matinee suits younger fans.

events.title: JP Hoe: Hoe Hoe Holiday Show

events.blurb: A holiday-themed concert presented by the Winnipeg Folk Festival's year-round Folk in the City series.

events.title: Jeu avec les briques Duplo
events.blurb: A free French-language Duplo drop-in for ages 0–5 and their caregivers at the Saint-Boniface branch.

events.title: Jolly Jamboree
events.blurb: Holiday songs and stories followed by a celebration-themed craft. Free, but registration is required and it was nearly full at last check.

events.title: Manitoba Moose 10-game home stand
events.blurb: The Moose's longest home stand of 2026-27; individual dates not confirmed.

events.title: Manitoba Moose Homestand (10 straight home games)
events.blurb: Moose's longest home stand of 2026-27. Check schedule for games.

events.title: Manitoba Moose vs. Iowa Wild
events.blurb: The Moose kick off a 10-game homestand with a Saturday matinee against the Wild's prospects.

events.title: Oh Ho Holiday Drag Brunch
events.blurb: Second holiday-themed drag brunch of the season at a Broadway venue.

events.blurb: Drama and soulful music come together for an evening celebrating Christmas the African way. Tickets $30.

events.title: Orienteering Adventure
events.blurb: Grab a map and navigate FortWhyte's landmarks on a self-guided orienteering challenge; no registration needed. Also on Dec 8.

events.title: Oxford Heights Annual Craft and Vendor Market
events.venue: Oxford Heights Community Club, 359 Dowling Ave E
events.blurb: Transcona's Oxford Heights Community Club hosts its annual craft and vendor market, a late-season stop for last-minute gifts. Listed in Travel Manitoba's 2026 craft sale guide; check the organizer for hours.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa
events.venue: IKEA Winnipeg, 500 Sterling Lyon Pkwy (Swedish Restaurant)
events.blurb: IKEA's breakfast with Santa in the Swedish Restaurant costs $4.99 per child (12 and under) and $9.99 per IKEA Family adult. Tickets are sold in-store only at the restaurant checkout until Dec 13 or until they sell out.

events.title: Pancakes & Pajamas With Santa
events.venue: Manitoba Children's Museum (45 Forks Market Rd)
events.blurb: Come in pyjamas for a pancake breakfast and a visit with Santa, held in timed sessions while the museum is closed to everyone but ticket holders. Tickets are $18–20 plus GST per person, sold at the admissions desk or by calling 204-924-4000.

events.title: Proper, Vol. 15
events.blurb: Proper YWG's intimate underground house night, an all-vinyl showcase with Joe Silva, Brent Phillips and Shael. 18+, limited capacity, and phones are asked to stay off the dance floor.

events.title: St. Adolphe Christmas Market
events.blurb: A two-day Christmas market in the St. Adolphe arena, just south of the city, with local artisans and holiday food.

events.title: Tales from the Touch Museum
events.venue: Richardson Interpretive Centre, FortWhyte Alive, 1961 McCreary Rd
events.blurb: A hands-on interpretive session on local wildlife, their adaptations, habitats and diets, suggested for ages 4 and up. Included with general admission (free for members); no registration needed.

events.title: The Island of Misfit Toys
events.venue: Garden Park Baptist Church, 1825 Inkster Blvd
events.blurb: Garden Park Church's free Christmas dessert theatre, put on as two shows. Bring a stuffed animal for the toy drive.

events.title: The JP Hoe Hoe Hoe After Party
events.blurb: The official late-night after-party for JP Hoe's annual Hoe Hoe Hoe Holiday Show moves down to Osborne. 18+, doors at 10.

events.title: The Jury Experience: The Killer AI
events.blurb: An immersive 60-minute courtroom drama in which the audience is the jury and decides whether the accused is guilty after a driverless car kills someone. Runs to Feb 5, 2027. Tickets are $24-$58 through Fever.

events.title: UNF Christmas Market
events.blurb: A Christmas fair celebrating Ukrainian culture and craft, with local artisans, makers and small businesses on the North End's Main Street.

events.title: Winnipeg Craft Explosion Market
events.blurb: A weekend vendor and craft market held at a Winnipeg farmers' market venue.

events.blurb: 714 House Media's evening holiday market with local makers and handmade gifts, a 'Deck the Cars' decorated-vehicle show and a photo scavenger hunt. $5 entry, kids free.

events.title: Christmas in Hawaii Luau Party
events.venue: Elkhorn Resort Spa & Conference Centre, Onanole (Riding Mountain)
events.blurb: A tropical-themed Christmas night at Elkhorn Resort by Clear Lake, with island-style food and a show. Show-only tickets are $25 and dinner-and-show is $58, and there are one- and two-night getaway packages if you want to make a weekend of it.

events.title: Fireside Music
events.blurb: Cozy holiday concert of winter classics and festive favourites arranged for mandolin orchestra, with free hot chocolate after. Pay what you can.

events.title: Grunthal Christmas Market
events.blurb: A casual one-day Christmas market in Grunthal with local vendors, crafts and holiday baking. Free admission.

events.title: Used Rental Equipment Sale & Indoor Soft Opening
events.venue: Asessippi Ski Area & Resort, near Inglis
events.blurb: Asessippi sells off its used rental skis and boards and opens its indoor facilities for the season. A good chance to gear up cheaply before the holidays.

events.title: Winter Family Story Time
events.blurb: A 30-minute drop-in session of winter stories and songs that builds early reading skills, for children and their families. Harvey Smith Library has another session on December 14 at 6 PM.

events.venue: Gas Station Arts Centre, 445 River Ave
events.blurb: Local importers pour natural, organic and low-intervention wines, with a grazing table, DJ GeNie and a pop-up vintage sale. Tickets are $75, including a $25 tax receipt, and support the GSAC renovation. Tickets are limited.

events.title: Reading in the Dark: a Horror Book Club
events.blurb: A free book club for readers who like ghosts, hauntings, monsters and killers. Titles deal with mature subject matter.

events.title: NFB Film Club: Bodies, Boundaries and Becoming
events.venue: Millennium Library, Carol Shields Auditorium, 251 Donald St
events.blurb: A free screening of four National Film Board shorts on identity, embodiment and transformation, told through intimate and experimental storytelling (78 min).

events.title: Borealis Beading Circle
events.venue: Explore Indigenous / Turtle Tours, The Forks
events.blurb: Pull up a chair and bead in good company at this drop-in circle at The Forks.

events.title: Breakfast with Santa

events.title: Canada Life Free Sundays at WAG-Qaumajuq
events.blurb: Free afternoon admission to the gallery and Qaumajuq on the second Sunday of the month.

events.title: Christmas Market
events.blurb: 20+ vendors in the North End; free entry, or $5 for a door-prize draw. Bring a tin for the bin, toiletries or a new toy for extra prize tickets.

events.title: Christmas with The Phil: Star of Wonder
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Philharmonic Choir's holiday concert features guest choir the Winnipeg Boys Choir, conducted by Carolyn Boyes, plus audience carol sing-alongs. There are two performances only.

events.title: Have a Murray Little Christmas
events.blurb: The Murray Riddell Big Band's holiday concert of big-band Christmas arrangements.

events.title: Heel Appeal Presents: LIMELIGHT
events.blurb: Heel Appeal takes over the Park Theatre stage for its LIMELIGHT showcase; doors at 5 PM.

events.title: Holiday Ride with Santa and Mrs. Claus
events.blurb: Kids of all ages ride horses alongside Santa and Mrs. Claus, about 30 minutes east of Winnipeg. Registration is about $33 per child.

events.title: Kids Nature Craft
events.blurb: A drop-in afternoon where kids make crafts from natural materials, included with FortWhyte admission. You can pair it with a walk on the winter trails.

events.title: Living Music Winnipeg: Winter Recital
events.blurb: An all-ages Sunday afternoon recital from Living Music Winnipeg students at the Osborne Village listening room. Doors open at 1 PM.

events.title: Manitoba Moose vs. Iowa Wild
events.blurb: Sunday afternoon rematch with Iowa at the downtown rink.

events.blurb: A dress-up Christmas tea party for kids aged 6-12 and their grown-ups, with a nutcracker hunt through the historic house, festive crafts, cookies and tea. $12 ($10 members). Spots are limited.

events.title: Rockin' Elvis Christmas with Rory Allen
events.blurb: Rory Allen channels the King for a rockin' Christmas show at Club Regent.

events.title: Staycation: The Art of Being Here
events.blurb: A WAG exhibition exploring home, place and the art of being present, on view through mid-December 2026.

events.title: The Stray Horns play Ella's Swingin' Christmas
events.blurb: The Stray Horns swing through Ella Fitzgerald's classic Christmas album in two Jazz at the Fort Garry Hotel shows, one in the afternoon and one at 7 pm. Hotel jazz series shows tend to fill up.

events.title: St. Thomas Anglican Church Christmas Dinner
events.venue: St. Thomas Anglican Church, 1567 William Ave W

events.title: FROST: A Cirque Holiday Extravaganza
events.blurb: A touring cirque holiday spectacle of acrobatics and winter-themed showpieces, for one night only at the Concert Hall.

events.title: Making with Magformers
events.blurb: Kids build 3D creatures, cars and castles with Magformers magnetic construction sets. Free, for ages 6-12; 60 minutes.

events.title: The Griswold Christmas Party
events.blurb: A seated screening of National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation. Your ticket includes a rum-and-eggnog or a draft, and there are prizes for the best ugly sweaters and Cousin Eddie costumes. 18+.

events.title: WSO Holiday Tour
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Symphony Orchestra's holiday program ends its regional tour in Brandon. The Steinbach stop has already sold out.

events.title: Winter Brunch
events.venue: Wetland Discovery Centre, Oak Hammock Marsh (1 Snow Goose Bay, Stonewall)
events.blurb: A family-style brunch overlooking the frozen marsh, with pre-registration required.

events.blurb: The December meeting discusses B.K. Borison's cozy romance Good Spirits, over sweets at Milksmith at The Forks.

events.title: Choir! Choir! Choir!
events.blurb: The audience is the choir: Toronto's Choir! Choir! Choir! leads a giant singalong at the Burt.

events.title: Christmas Wonders
events.blurb: Holiday stories, songs and a homemade Christmas card for ages 3-5 with a caregiver. Free, with registration required.

events.title: Mike Paramore at Rumor's
events.blurb: Mike Paramore headlines the last full week of stand-up at Rumor's before the holidays.

events.blurb: Film screening at Sidestage, presented with Black Square. All ages; tickets via TicketWeb.

events.blurb: A Christmas date night for the 20th anniversary of the Kate Winslet and Cameron Diaz rom-com, with twinkle lights, a glass of wine or a draft, and a photo by the tree. 18+.

events.title: Bannock Making in Anishinaabe
events.venue: Selkirk Friendship Centre, 425 Eveline St, Selkirk
events.blurb: The Friendship Centre's language program runs a free hands-on bannock-making workshop taught using words in Anishinaabemowin.

events.blurb: Winnipeg stage veteran Richard Hurst returns to Dalnavert, where he read Dickens' classic for years in the 1990s and 2000s. Recommended for ages 10 and up. $30 ($25 members).

events.title: Cara Luft
events.blurb: Folk favourite Cara Luft (The Small Glories) hosts a seasonal show for people who've had enough carols.

events.title: Celebrate the Season
events.blurb: A wintry story time with a snowman craft for little ones aged 0-5 and their caregivers. Free, with registration required.

events.title: Choir! Choir! Choir! - Un-Silent Night
events.blurb: Audience holiday sing-along event led by the Choir! Choir! Choir! collective.

events.title: Manitoba Moose vs. Rockford IceHogs
events.blurb: Second Project 11 School Day game of the season, with a 10:30 a.m. puck drop.

events.title: Two Cuckolds Go Swimming
events.blurb: Winston DeGiobbi and Deragh Campbell's Canadian indie, in which a simple road trip turns emotionally extreme.

events.title: Winnipeg Christmas Lights Sightseeing Tour

events.blurb: Heartland Travel's guided motorcoach tour visits the camels at the Legislative Building, Candy Cane Lane, Polar Bear Lane and Nutcracker Street, with carols and Christmas-light bingo along the way. Tickets are $34.65 for adults and $21 for kids. As of Nov 18 only 8 seats were left, and the Dec 18 departure is already sold out. Book by phone at 204-989-9630.

events.title: Wolseley Wander to The Forks
events.venue: Meet at Raglan Rd & Wolseley Ave
events.blurb: A Nature Manitoba group winter walk from Wolseley along the Assiniboine to The Forks. Meet at Raglan Road and Wolseley Avenue.

events.title: New Friend Night
events.venue: Across the Board Game Café, 211 Bannatyne Ave
events.blurb: A guided board-game night of large and small group games for meeting new people. $12; the series continues into February.

events.title: Sistema Winnipeg Winter Concert
events.venue: Maples Commons, Maples Collegiate, 1330 Jefferson Ave
events.blurb: The young musicians of the WSO's Sistema Winnipeg program play their Tannis M. Richardson winter concert, conducted by Monica Chen. Free, and donations are welcome.

events.title: Brandon Wheat Kings vs. Prince Albert Raiders
events.venue: Assiniboine Credit Union Place (Keystone Centre), Brandon
events.blurb: The Wheat Kings' last home game before Christmas, against the Prince Albert Raiders in an Eastern Conference matchup.

events.title: 60th Anniversary of How the Grinch Stole Christmas
events.blurb: The Winnipeg Jazz Orchestra marks the Grinch's 60th with the Vince Guaraldi-era holiday jazz treatment, featuring Quinn Greene. Two shows, at 12:45 pm and 7:30 pm.

events.title: Astronomy Night: Winter Constellations
events.venue: Oak Hammock Marsh Wetland Discovery Centre, Stonewall
events.blurb: Oak Hammock Marsh's monthly astronomy night turns to the winter constellations, with a presentation and rooftop telescope viewing. $15 ($10 members).

events.title: Brandon Men's Bonspiel with a Berth
events.blurb: A competitive men's bonspiel whose winner earns a berth in the provincial men's championship. Strong teams from across Manitoba usually enter.

events.title: Candlelight: Christmas Classics
events.blurb: A string performance of holiday classics in a hall lit by thousands of candles. Tickets from about $32. A separate Christmas Carols on Strings program also plays Dec 19 (https://feverup.com/m/614237).

events.title: Cindy & The City: The 4th Annual Sick + Twisted Holiday Panto
events.venue: West End Cultural Centre, 586 Ellice Ave
events.blurb: Sick + Twisted Theatre's fourth annual Christmas panto runs Dec 17-18 and Dec 26-31, then Jan 2-3, 2027, in a relaxed, all-ages environment. Tickets $10-$30 with pay-what-you-can; mask-mandatory shows Dec 29 and Jan 3, and the Jan 2 show is ASL-interpreted, audio described and live streamed.

events.title: Family Art Night
events.blurb: A free drop-in evening of art and crafts for children and their families, with plenty of supplies for making your own masterpiece.

events.title: It's a Wonderful Life
events.blurb: Kids in the Hall's Kevin McDonald presents the 4K restoration of Capra's holiday classic for his McDonald at the Movies series.

events.blurb: Winnipeg songwriter Jacob Brodovsky launches a new album of sharp, wry indie-folk.

events.title: Kissed by Fire, Evan James St Cyr & The Ryan Whiskeys
events.blurb: Three local acts share a pre-holiday bill at Sidestage. About $19, all ages, doors at 7.

events.title: Christmas Toddler Time
events.blurb: Holiday books, songs and rhymes that teach toddlers letters, numbers, colours and shapes. It's for children 19-36 months with a caregiver, and registration is required.

events.title: Ben Albert

events.title: Best of Bands as Bands: Amyl and the Sniffers, Arctic Monkeys & Steely Dan
events.blurb: Local musicians play as Amyl and the Sniffers, Arctic Monkeys and Steely Dan in a best-of edition of Bands as Bands.

events.title: CreativeMornings Winnipeg
events.venue: The Event Space, The Forks Market
events.blurb: Monthly creative community breakfast talk. Also listed Nov 27.

events.title: Holiday Story Time
events.blurb: Holiday stories, songs and rhymes, plus a festive craft to take home. For ages 3-5 with a caregiver. Free, with registration required.

events.title: Krissmuss & Khaos: A Sinners' Krissmuss
events.blurb: A Caribbean-Christmas themed nightclub party with reggae and dancehall vibes.

events.title: Makers & Vendors Market: Holiday Market
events.blurb: Last-minute holiday shopping from local makers. Dates and venue lower confidence.

events.title: Manitoba Moose vs. Rockford IceHogs (Holiday Game)
events.blurb: AHL hockey holiday-weekend game as the Manitoba Moose host the Rockford IceHogs.

events.title: Munschbusters!
events.blurb: PTE's holiday tradition: high-energy stagings of Robert Munsch stories including Alligator Baby, Mud Puddle and The Boy in the Drawer, adapted by Debbie Patterson. Ages 3+, runs through Jan 3, 2027.

events.title: Prairie Unity Competition Pow Wow

events.title: Rex: A Dinosaur's Story
events.blurb: Olivia Norquay presents a remastered holiday cult curio for Cult-O-Rama, in partnership with Sookram's Brewing Co.

events.title: Royal Winnipeg Ballet: Nutcracker
events.blurb: The Royal Winnipeg Ballet's holiday Nutcracker has about a dozen performances from Dec 18 to Dec 27, closing with a 1:00 pm matinee and a 6:30 pm show on Dec 27. Tickets start at $45, and holiday dates tend to sell out, so book early.

events.title: Shmani, CCIV & Devon Dare
events.blurb: A late-starting Friday triple bill at Sidestage with Shmani, CCIV and Devon Dare. All ages.

events.title: Snow Place Like Home

events.blurb: A drive-thru winter light show at the Hanover Ag grounds in Grunthal, about 45 minutes southeast of Winnipeg. Admission is charged per vehicle, about $20-$30, and wagon or sleigh rides through the lights run on select nights.

events.title: Stones vs Beatles

events.blurb: A tribute showdown night pitting Rolling Stones and Beatles setlists against each other.

events.title: The Day She Returns
events.blurb: Hong Sangsoo's latest is a quiet meditation on memory and performance.

events.title: Vinterfest Market at IKEA
events.blurb: A Scandinavian-flavoured last-minute gift stop: Manitoba Craft Council members sell their work inside IKEA on the final weekend before Christmas.

events.title: Late-Night Skiing
events.venue: Asessippi Ski Area & Resort, near Inglis
events.blurb: The Squirrel Chair and Bunny Hill run under floodlights until 10 pm, with $20 late-night lift tickets and $20 rentals. Willow plays O'Lifty's Pub at 8 pm.

events.title: The Zabava Hour Live: Christmas Edition
events.venue: Fellowship Hall, Peace Lutheran Church, 350 Gilmore Ave
events.blurb: Brad Salyn's quarterly Ukrainian Canadian music jam goes festive, with a Christmas market from Kolo Shop, hot chocolate, treats and Ukrainian Christmas music. Free admission.

events.title: Arctic Glacier Winter Park Opens
events.blurb: Seasonal opening of the outdoor skating and winter recreation area at The Forks.

events.title: Christmas Bird Count
events.venue: Oak Hammock Marsh Wetland Discovery Centre, Stonewall
events.blurb: Join one of the world's biggest and oldest citizen-science projects by helping tally the marsh's winter resident birds. Register ahead; optional lunch available.

events.title: Falcon Ridge Ski Slopes Opening Day

events.blurb: The Whiteshell's downhill hill is aiming for a Dec 19 opening, then runs Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. The date depends on the weather, so check the hill's updates before you drive out.

events.title: Family Game Afternoon
